Browser cookie database fixtures, generated by
`tools/capture_browser_cookies.py UPSTREAM_CHECKOUT "$PWD/tests/fixtures/browser_cookies"`
against the pinned upstream checkout. `expected.json` records the cookies and
logger messages upstream's `extract_cookies_from_browser` produced for each
profile and container (absolute fixture paths replaced with `FIXTURES`).

The Firefox databases use 512-byte pages so that the native SQLite reader
covers interior b-tree pages, overflow chains and rows written before an
`ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN`.

`chrome/` holds Chromium profiles whose `v10` values are encrypted for the
macOS keychain password in `chrome/password.txt` (meta version 24 with the
SHA-256 host prefix, and a pre-24 profile using the legacy `secure` column);
upstream's expectations are captured on macOS with its keychain lookup
patched to that password.
